notes.title: UNICLR v1.04 Update (Apr 28th)
notes.content:
Fixed the following battle balance issues for certain characters:
- Linne
Fixed an issue where using her "Soaring Swallow" will occasionally cause her to leap over the opponent, causing her to whiff.
- Seth
Fixed an issue where using his "Rapid Descent" into "Additional input 1" against a cornered opponent will cause him to end up on the other side.
- Chaos
Fixed an issue where Smart steering will enable him to use Azhi Dahaka's special moves despite being under restriction. 
- Mika
Fixed an issue where "Mika's Cannon" has different knockback properties depending on the side she is on.

Fixed an issue where the game language setting changes to Japanese upon update from UNIST to UNICLR, and visiting the Options menu.
Increased video quality of the opening movie.
Incremented replay data version. As a result, older replays may not playback correctly.

notes.title: UNICLR v1.03b Online stats hotfix (Apr 7th)
notes.content:
We have applied the following fix as of today:
 Fixed the online stats data.

Initially, all of the user's online-related data are supposed to have been reset upon the update to UNICLR. However it was found out that the reset was not carried out as expected, and thus it caused a huge amount of miscalculations. As such, upon this fix, we will have to reset or rewind some of the save data, as follows:
 RIP score shall be restored as closely as possible back to pre-UNICLR update state (last state of UNIST).
 All matchup scores shall be reset. As a result, the consequtive win score shall also be reset.

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused.

notes.title: Patch1.03kr (April 3rd, 2019)
notes.content:
The following contents have been installed in this update：

 The game now supports Korean language.

notes.title: Patch1.03 (November 22nd, 2018)
notes.content:
The following issue has been fixed in this hot-fix patch:

 Fixed an issue that occurs during 2 player gameplay where the controller input does not register in certain situation.
 Fixed an issue in Training mode where the training dummy will move unintendedly during certain situation.
 Implemented a feature where during server initialization failure,  players will still be able to play on the Network Mode.

We understand that several users are experiencing issues with regards to connect to network and having disconnections during online gameplay.
We would like to seek your cooperation to aid us in investigating the issue.

For more information, please refer to the link below:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/801630/discussions/0/3317353727658169305/

We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

notes.title: Patch1.02 (October 11th, 2018)
notes.content:
The following issue has been fixed in this hot-fix patch:

Fixed an issue in Training Mode, where the Input Lag will not be reflected when playing on a controller.
A text log will be generated when encountering a network error during gameplay in the Default branch.
A more detailed log will be generated when encountering a network error.

We understand that several users are experiencing issues with regards to connect to network and having disconnections during online gameplay.
We would like to seek your cooperation to aid us in investigating the issue.

For more information, please refer to the link below:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/801630/discussions/0/3317353727658169305/

We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

notes.title: Patch1.01 (September 26th, 2018)
notes.content:
The following issue has been fixed in this hot-fix patch:

Implemented a countermeasure for users who are unable to connect to Network Mode.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

notes.title: Hot-Fix (September 3rd, 2018)
notes.content:
The following issue has been fixed in this hot-fix patch:

Fixed an issue in "Training " mode where the recorded action of the training dummy does not play correctly when the action is recorded using keyboard controls.
Fixed an issue where multiple buttons are pressed during battle when using the keyboard.
Fixed an issue where frame drops occur during game play in "Network" mode. 

We apologize for the inconvenience caused.
